Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the definition of a rural county for public facilities' sales and use tax purposes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the definition of a rural county for publicfacilities' sales and use tax purposes; and adding a new section tochapter 82.14 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any county that borders a state without a sales tax is an eligiblecounty for purposes of the provisions of RCW 82.14.370 regardingestablishing a sales and use tax to finance public facilities servingeconomic development purposes.
